sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent defeat. Sandbach remain top with 22 points from 10 games despite that loss, and face a struggling Alsager side who sit bottom with just 4 points and have won only once all season. This should be a strong opportunity for the leaders to return to winning ways.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday—a key fixture for maintaining their title challenge as they sit just 2 points behind Sandbach. The top of the table remains competitive, with third-placed AFC Bridgnorth (19 points) hosting Eccleshall, who are fifth on 18 points and notably winning their last fixture. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, visit Wednesfield Community (13 points) in a mid-table clash. In-form Bilston Town (5th place, 17 points) travel to Foley Meir in what looks like a battle between mid-table sides. Market Drayton Town host New Mills, both on 12-14 points and searching for consistency. Brereton Social entertain Widnes Town—bottom-placed Widnes have won just once and drawn twice all season, making this a potentially valuable opportunity for Brereton. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a fixture between two struggling sides near the foot of the table. Crewe host Allscott Heath in another lower-table encounter. Shawbury United face Barnton; Shawbury are in poor form with five consecutive defeats, while Barnton remain in mid-table. Additionally, a midweek fixture sees Brereton Social visit Wednesfield Community on Wednesday at 19:45.
